title: Back model provider service credentials with a Unity Catalog secret
body: Back a model provider service's API key with a customer-owned Unity Catalog secret. The service reads it at query time, so rotating the secret takes effect with no service change. See [Back a provider credential with a Unity Catalog secret](/aws/en/ai-gateway/create-model-provider-services#uc-secret-auth).
